<!-- GENERATED by spikes/s67-docs-by-example (ADR 0104) from conformance/tests/cljg-security-password.clj — do not edit.

Password hashing is one function call — argon2id, the modern default, salted for you.

cljg.security passwords (ADR 0103): hash-password emits a self-describing argon2id PHC string and check-password round-trips it — printing ONLY booleans (the salted hash is random per call and must never be frozen or printed). A wrong password and a non-hash string are both false, never an error.

```clojure
(require '[cljg.security :as sec])
(require '[clojure.string :as str])
(def h (sec/hash-password "hunter2"))
[(string? h)
 (str/starts-with? h "$argon2id$")
 (sec/check-password "hunter2" h)
 (sec/check-password "wrong-password" h)
 (sec/check-password "hunter2" "not-a-hash")]
```

Output:

```clojure
[true true true false false]
```

Run it yourself — save as `ex.clj` and:

```bash
cljgo run ex.clj      # interpreted, instant
cljgo build           # or ship it as a static binary
```
